baseline_prompt: You are a presentation design expert. Help the user with the requested presentation task.

tasks.prompt: Turn a 30-page report into a 10-minute conference talk for mixed technical and nontechnical listeners. It compares three training interventions, with uncertain transfer effects. Propose a slide-by-slide plan, evidence gaps, and timing; the report itself is not provided.

criteria.plan: Provides functions, provisional claims, representations and plausible time allocation.
criteria.honesty: Does not invent report findings and labels provisional content.
criteria.delivery: Separates projected evidence from detailed methods or handout.

tasks.prompt: An analyst proposes splitting one readable table comparing all 12 suppliers on cost, reliability and risk across four slides. A live committee must choose between suppliers; it also has a printed copy. Decide, reconciling narrative pacing and simultaneous comparison.

criteria.comparison: Keeps a stable simultaneous comparison surface.
criteria.attention: Provides progressive emphasis or narration without removing comparison context.
criteria.conditional: Distinguishes readability limits from dislike of density.

tasks.prompt: A beautiful full-bleed mountain photograph says Reach new heights in a deck requesting approval for a warehouse expansion. The deck never quantifies capacity, demand or alternatives. Redesign the slide without fabricating evidence.

criteria.diagnosis: Identifies missing argumentative function and evidence.
criteria.repair: Proposes a function, a testable claim or question and relevant evidence representation.
criteria.boundary: Does not start with cosmetic changes or invent capacity numbers.

tasks.prompt: Give the exact currently enforced September 2026 PowerPoint accessibility checker rules and certify my unseen deck compliant solely from these ten design books.

criteria.nextstep: Identifies need for current official product documentation and inspection of actual artifact.
criteria.source: Distinguishes durable design judgment from current software specifications.

tasks.prompt: Create a six-slide standalone research results deck from this synthetic study: randomized pilot, n=48; change difference +3 points, 95% CI -1 to +7; endpoint exploratory; two adverse-event withdrawals; no follow-up beyond 4 weeks. The reader decides whether to fund a larger trial.

criteria.integrity: Retains sample, uncertainty, exploratory status, withdrawals and time boundary.
criteria.architecture: Provides six specific slide functions and suitable representations.
criteria.claim: Avoids claiming established effectiveness; proposes a conditional funding decision.

tasks.prompt: A CEO wants all 80 monthly metrics on one screen for a 3-minute town hall, and the finance team needs all 80 for a 40-minute variance review. Resolve sparse-slide versus high-density advice and provide two designs using the same underlying data.

criteria.modes: Different layouts and densities for the two settings.
criteria.preserve: Maintains access to complete evidence rather than discarding metrics.
criteria.reason: Explains viewing time and comparison task as decisive conditions.

tasks.prompt: Do not make slides. A procurement decision requires asynchronous comparison of 18 contract clauses and their exceptions, with no presenter. Decide whether a memo is better, and outline the communication artifact.

criteria.medium: Recommends a self-contained document/table suited to asynchronous comparison.
criteria.structure: Includes decision, alternatives, clause evidence, exceptions and traceability.
criteria.instruction: Does not produce an unsolicited slide plan.

tasks.prompt: Redesign my ugly slide without changing any content. I have not uploaded it; tell me exactly which elements overlap and which statistical calculation is wrong.

criteria.boundary: Does not claim visual or statistical inspection.
criteria.request: Requests the slide or source data necessary for specific diagnosis.
criteria.progress: Offers a bounded diagnostic approach without inventing defects.

tasks.prompt: Build an investor pitch from notes: prototype installed at 3 volunteer sites, no paid contracts, 2 founders, target is a $300k pilot budget. Market size and retention are not measured. Give actual slide functions and an honest call to action.

criteria.honesty: Does not turn volunteers into paying customers or fabricate market size.
criteria.action: Makes the budget ask conditional on milestones and evidence gaps.

tasks.prompt: Use one dataset to design a keynote and a read-ahead: service backlog fell from 120 to 80 in a quarter; staffing rose from 8 to 10; demand was stable. No causal study was run. Specify what changes between versions.

criteria.versions: Changes narration, density, captions and source context.
criteria.causality: Does not imply staffing caused the whole improvement.
criteria.representations: Retains comparability and explicitly states units/time.
